Skyes Over London Crypto Materials Mini Suite

Files included in this package:
- index.html  -> shared suite launcher portal
- JWTSecretGenerator-mini-suite-logo-intro.html
- sovereign-variables-mini-suite-logo-intro.html
- SKYESOVERLONDONDIETYLOGO.png

Keep every file in the same folder. Open index.html first to launch the suite portal.

What changed in this package:
- shared launcher portal
- branded intro scene on launcher and both apps
- shimmer title reveal
- progress-synced logo glow / wing pulse treatment
- sound-ready browser events: sol:intro:start, sol:intro:halfway, sol:intro:complete
- app-to-app links updated to the logo-intro builds

Notes:
- This is a local browser mini suite. It uses browser storage for persistence.
- The logo file must remain next to the HTML files.
- If you rename files, update the internal path constants in the apps.


Update:
- Full Sovereign Variables app now lives at sovereign-variables/index.html
- Legacy sovereign mini-suite paths redirect into the full app
